# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 F2: the AI's grant for upholding Imperial Authority. Generated by gen_byz_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope (root of ai_maintenance_value in oe_pillars_authority_budget; also the readout). The slider the AI should
# hold for upholding Imperial Authority: 1 below 40 authority while the purse holds the reserve (3 months of
# purse income, oe_pillars_law_change_cost); 0.5 while the purse has gold and income and authority is below 90;
# otherwise 0. The slider spends purse income only, never the treasury.
oe_byz_ai_auth_budget = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                has_variable = oe_pillars_authority
                var:oe_pillars_authority < 90
                gold > 0
                oe_pillars_purse_monthly_income > 0
            }
        }
        value = 0.5
        if = {
            limit = {
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                    var:oe_pillars_authority < 40
                    gold >= oe_pillars_law_change_cost
                }
            }
            value = 1
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Readout: the slider Byzantium holds now (0..1; the AI's or the player's).
oe_byz_ai_auth_slider = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        value = "payment_maintenance(international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars|oe_pillars_authority_budget)"
    }
}
# IO scope (the Pillars). Readout: the purse.
oe_byz_ai_purse = { value = gold }
# BYZ scope. Readout: the treasury.
oe_byz_ai_gold = { value = gold }
